item.title: 36,000 gallons of wastewater released after pipeline rupture near South Bay plant
item.description: A pipeline rupture near the South Bay International Wastewater Treatment Plant released approximately 36,000 gallons of wastewater, but crews responded quickly to contain the spill and prevent it from reaching the Tijuana River.

item.title: Wrong-way driver who led police on I-15 pursuit in San Diego identified
item.description: Authorities have released the name of the driver who caused an hours-long slowdown and closure on a portion of Interstate 15 in San Diego and led police on a pursuit before being detained Tuesday morning.

item.title: Man arrested after impersonating officer, assaults McDonald’s manager
item.description: A man was arrested for impersonating a police officer at a McDonald's in University City, after he allegedly put the manager on duty in a chokehold while claiming the Hispanic man was an "illegal alien".

item.title: Over 500 weighted therapy bears donated to San Diego hospitals for 'Heal A Heart Day'
item.description: The Comfort Cub, a nonprofit organization, donated 500 weighted therapeutic teddy bears to San Diego hospitals to provide comfort to families facing unimaginable loss.

item.title: PHOTOS: Newborns receive Valentine’s Day outfits at Rady Children’s NICU
item.description: (FOX 5/KUSI) -- As Valentine’s Day approaches, Rady Children’s Hospital staff tried to make the holiday extra special for these newborn babies. item.title: Fatal collision in Crest claims life of woman, DUI suspected
item.description: A fatal crash on La Cresta Road in the Crest area on Wednesday afternoon left a 72-year-old woman dead, and authorities suspect alcohol was a factor in the crash.

item.title: San Diego trash bin rollout 70% complete as some residents report ongoing issues
item.description: The City of San Diego has delivered 172,801 new gray trash bins to 160,725 customers and removed 183,130 old black bins, with the process expected to be completed by late spring, though some residents have experienced delays and missing bins.

item.title: Teens steal flowers from minority-owned pop up shop days before Valentine's Day
item.description: A group of teenage boys stole three bouquets of roses worth nearly $300 from Mitri's Delights, a Valentine's Day shop, causing the owner to feel violated and ask for justice.

item.title: SUV involved in fatal Pacific Beach hit-and-run found by police
item.description: Police have recovered the White Mercedes SUV suspected to be involved in a deadly hit-and-run in Pacific Beach, and a GoFundMe has been created to raise funds for the victim's family.
